name: Kraken Waterborne
source_type: sigil (Inscryption fandom wiki page Waterborne, read 29 Oct 2026, supplement)
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil submerges during its opponent's turn: an opposing creature attacks the space directly, skipping over it. When it re-emerges it transforms into a random Tentacle card (Bell Tentacle, Hand Tentacle, Mirror Tentacle), losing this sigil and its other sigils.

name: Gemified
source_type: sigil (Inscryption fandom wiki page Gemification, read 29 Oct 2026, supplement)
text: A card chosen at the Gemification event (Act III) is Gemified: it gains no sigil, but while its owner has a Green Gem it has 2 more Health, with an Orange Gem 1 more Power, and with a Blue Gem it costs 1 Energy less.
